title: Offline Trainer - Sr. Executive / Assistant Manager
description:
**Job Description:**

The South Zone SPOC Trainer will be the single point of contact (SPOC) for the assigned zone, driving sales enablement, product-led growth, leadership development, and Associate Buyer (AB) upliftment across her region.

This role is not limited to training delivery—it is a hybrid Sales + Training + Field Enablement function where the trainer directly contributes to:

Zonal sales target fulfilment

AB development & capability upliftment

Product penetration.

SPOC Trainer will represent the KeySoul brand in the field, ensuring the right messaging, product positioning, and behaviour standards across all levels of the network. Strong field presence, influencing skills, grooming, and communication are essential.

**Key Result Areas:**

**Zone Ownership & Sales Enablement**

· Act as the sole responsible SPOC for all KeySoul training and capability-building activities within the zone.

· Drive zonal targets through structured product trainings, motivation sessions, and strategy alignment with field leadership.

· Track zone-wise sales, identify performance gaps, and convert training into measurable outcomes.

· Support ABs and leaders in product pitching, business building, and confidence enhancement.

· Ensure KeySoul products achieve consistent visibility and advocacy in the field.

**Field Training & Product-Led Growth**  
· Conduct high-impact offline product trainings for ABs, leaders, depot teams, and field influencers.

· Translate product features, benefits, differentiators, and usage demonstrations into sales conversions.

· Develop AB capabilities to confidently promote, explain, and recommend KeySoul products.

**Leadership & AB Development**

· Identify high-potential ABs and prepare them for higher responsibilities.

· Facilitate sessions in:

Personality & grooming

Communication & presentation skills

Team leadership & field management

Motivation & retention

Improve AB performance, confidence, and selling capability through structured coaching.

**Content Development & Program Design**

· Collaborate with the Transformation team to develop customized learning content.

· Create and update training modules, product sheets, and capability decks aligned to KeySoul positioning.

· Ensure the integration of product marketing insights, differentiators, and brand philosophy into all training content.

**Brand Representation & Market Conduct**

· Uphold and promote the culture, values, and ethos of RCM & KeySoul in all field interactions.

· Maintain professional grooming and represent the brand with high credibility.

· Manage communication sensitively, avoiding misinformation or misrepresentation.

**Field Travel & Event Leadership**

· Travel across the zone to conduct trainings, events, leaders meeting, launches, and AB upskilling workshops.

· Lead on-ground brand campaigns, promotions, and educational drives for KeySoul.

**Reporting, MIS & Evaluation**

· Ensure timely submission of MIS, attendance, MRM reports, training logs, and performance dashboards.

· Design assessments, feedback tools, and evaluation mechanisms that measure training effectiveness.

**Focused Key Result Areas:**

· Zonal Sales & Target Achievement through Training Interventions

· Capability Building of ABs & Leaders

· Increase in KeySoul Product Penetration & PV Growth

· AB Leadership Pipeline Development in the Zone

Training-to-Sales Conversion Metrics

**Skills required:**

* Strong on-ground presence and personality
* Excellent communication in Hindi & English
* Strong field influencing & motivational ability
* Powerful presentation, facilitation, and storytelling skills
* Proven experience in cosmetics, personal care, or direct selling (preferred)
* Good understanding of makeup, skincare, and product demonstration
* Ability to translate product knowledge into sales outcomes
* High ownership, discipline, and accountability

**Work Experience:**   
From Training on the Cosmetics/Lingerie Products background. Should be well versed with MS Office. To be certified as Trainer in Cosmetics/Lingerie, Sense of make-up, Preferred from Direct Selling Industry Etc.

**Competencies Required:**

· Strong communication and presentation capability.

· High discipline and time management.

· Willingness to learn and adapt quickly.

· Strong product learning ability.

High energy and people-connect capability.

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹900,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: UKI Deal Support Specialist
description:
Location: Bengaluru

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Sep 16, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1743409

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Discipline**

Clients and Industries, Pursuits & Commercial Excellence

**Role Type**

Deal Support Specialist - Supervising Associate

  

**The opportunity**: EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) consists of various service delivery centres from which Client Service and Enablement Services teams operate to deliver strategic support to EY member firms. GDS spans all geographies, practices, services lines, sectors and competencies within EY to deliver integrated services that result in efficient and world-class solutions. The position in discussion is with the P&CE in EY GDS Clients and Industries Function. The GDS P&CE serves as an extension to the onshore Deals team who are involved in the direct Bid Management Processes. The P&CE supports the onshore teams on a number of opportunities, adding more value during the Deal process or the bid management cycle.

The Deal Support Specialist - Supervising Associate provides support in the different phases of the Deal process. This role will support the Pursuit Strategist/Leader in all the stages of the Bid Management Process, involving in pre-RFP, RFP response and post-RFP phase. The range of activities include project management, research, review and analytical support for the onshore Deal team throughout the bid management cycle. This role will support in executing globally consistent strategy.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

**Strategic Pursuit and Opportunity Management:**

* Gather information through secondary research (both internal and external sources) and generate top-notch deliverables such as company profiles, competitor insights, trend analysis, and other valuable assets to support pre and proposal development phases.
* Prepare and drive project management plan throughout the deal cycle by acting as a point of contact in managing the end-to-end process including but not limited to organising meetings, preparing meeting notes, finalising timelines and accountabilities as per deadlines.
* Owns the preparation of kick-off documents, CV collation for team book, orals preparation and credentials pack. Support the development and coordination of proposal content and submission documents in line with pursuit requirements.
* Liaise with the broader team in development of client collaterals such as storyboards, placemats, proposals and internal presentations
* Establish and maintain clear and transparent communication and build strong stakeholders’ relationships by exhibiting professional etiquettes and adhering to agreed timelines and quality benchmarks
* Manage a repository of Regional, Market Segment or Service Line client-facing collateral as appropriate
* Exhibit innovative thinking and flexible approach while managing complex and out-of-scope requests
* Own and maintain repository of client presentations, RFQ responses, marketing collateral, etc.
* Quality review of deliverables

  

**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**

* Critical thinking, organised, detail – oriented with strong analytical skills and the ability to meet tight deadlines
* Demonstrates excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across MS Teams, email and virtual meetings

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Exceptional English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to communicate confidently and professionally with senior UK stakeholders, including Partners, Directors and Pursuit Leaders. (Essential)
* Prior experience in deals/pre-sales/bid management and project management
* Experience supporting complex proposals, bids or pursuit opportunities in a professional services environment
* Good business acumen and understanding of business development, Deal/ project management and coordination skills
* Strong digital toolkit skills including Microsoft 365, AI-enabled tools and advanced online research techniques
* Experience with SharePoint is desirable
* Able to build collaborative relationships with a variety of stakeholders

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

**Education:**

* University/bachelor’s degree required
* Master’s in business administration

  

**Experience:**

* 5 years to 8 years
* Minimum 3 years' experience working within a large global organisation, preferably within a professional services environment
* Proven ability to influence and build collaborative relationships with a wide range of stakeholders
* Excellent written and spoken English is essential. The role involves daily interaction with UK-based stakeholders and requires the ability to participate confidently in meetings, manage communications independently and produce high-quality written outputs

  

**Certification Requirements:**

* Expected to remain current on EY training and curriculum
* APMP certification, PMP certification or equivalent bid/project management qualification would be advantageous

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Previous experience working directly with UK clients or UK stakeholder teams would be highly advantageous.
* As the job involves responding to clients’ needs and varying time zones, long/flexible hours are regularly required
* Moderate travel – for attending leadership meetings/trainings

  

**Technologies and Tools**

* Excellent Microsoft 365 skills including Copilot, PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Teams and SharePoint

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success, as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Associate - Financial Planning & Analysis
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

﻿Financial Analysis is responsible for partnering across the firm to provide financial and strategic analysis, oversight, and coordination of budgeting and forecasting. Our Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) teams are responsible for a wide range of activities including financial control, forecasting and budgeting, analysis of financial/business metrics, delivery of weekly/monthly/quarterly management reporting, development of new reporting capabilities (e.g. dashboards), and advising the line of business CFOs on how to increase profitability and efficiencies.

You will analyze, prepare, and reconcile accounting and technical data as well as prepare reports, while always thinking of and devising ways to streamline and minimize cycle times through automated applications and process improvement. You will also help develop recommendations effecting business procedures and operations and maintain financial and reporting systems. In addition, you will assist the department and other team members with special projects or components of other projects as needed.

In a Financial Analysis role, you would be responsible for:

* Managing annual/continual financial planning activities for product areas, providing business rationale and decisions for all month-end financial performance and forecasting, conducting reviews and analysis on product financial performance, consumption/demand planning, budgeting, billing, trends, and exception reports
* Efficiency reporting, analytics and strategy - including, but not limited to - location strategy, span of control, reporting and analytics
* Creating financial business cases supporting business initiatives
* Reporting on and monitoring key metrics, driving data quality initiatives across the product area, and helping define future needs of the product area
* Developing and tracking performance metrics, creating presentations, and generally providing financial analysis on a variety of topics to senior management
* Performing variance analysis to understand the key drivers of the results and presenting commentary to senior managers, explaining changes from prior forecasts/budgets
* Helping design new reports and dashboards to efficiently deliver the financial results to senior management
* Enhancing controls and streamlining processes, introducing automation where possible

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a subject of a technical nature
* 5+ years of work experience, preferably in Financial Services, and/or accounting/controller background
* Advanced skills in Excel and PowerPoint
* Proficiency with data mining/gathering and manipulation of data sets
* Inquisitive, enthusiastic and diligent, and capable of challenging peers
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex issues clearly
* Ability to create ad hoc reporting for senior management
* Proven track record for executing on special projects / assignments, often with little lead time or information
* Highly motivated and able to thrive and think clearly under pressure and tight deadlines
* Team player with the ability to be respected as a trusted partner for the Business, Finance, and FP&A Teams
* Highly motivated self-starter with excellent time management/prioritization skills
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills with ability to analyze large data sets and present conclusions concisely
* Proficiency with Alteryx and Gen AI tools would be a plus

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

  

Global Finance & Business Management works to strategically manage capital, drive growth and efficiencies, maintain financial reporting and proactively manage risk. By providing information, analysis and recommendations to improve results and drive decisions, teams ensure the company can navigate all types of market conditions while protecting our fortress balance sheet.
